label: CP-8(5)
title: Alternate Telecommunication Service Testing

statement.prose: Test alternate telecommunication services {{ insert: param, cp-08.05_odp }}.

guidance: Alternate telecommunications services testing is arranged through contractual agreements with service providers. The testing may occur in parallel with normal operations to ensure that there is no degradation in organizational missions or functions.

params.label: frequency
guidelines: frequency at which alternate telecommunications services are tested is defined;
